name: Proton Pass
author: Elliot
description: Search Proton Pass items and inspect logins, notes, cards, and 2FA from the Omarchy bar.

barWidget.description: Search Proton Pass items and copy secrets from the bar.

schema.label: pass-cli path
schema.description: Command used to talk to Proton Pass. Use a full path if pass-cli is not on PATH.

schema.label: Cache lifetime (minutes)
schema.description: How long item titles stay on disk before a background refresh. Opening the panel always uses the cache; passwords and other secrets are never stored.

schema.label: Clipboard clear (seconds)
schema.description: Clear the clipboard this many seconds after copying a secret. 0 leaves the clipboard until something else overwrites it.
